nodes.description: Public boolean guard flag 'done' that records whether the spell has already been cast; prevents double execution.
Constant public string description of the spell ('Tinlake CF4 Mainnet Spell - 3').
Constant mainnet address ROOT of the Tinlake root (ward) contract that authorizes contracts.
Constant mainnet address NAV_FEED of the Tinlake NAV feed contract whose risk groups are configured.
Constant ray unit ONE = 10**27 used as the threshold/ceiling ratio arguments passed to the NAV feed.
Storage address 'self' set to address(this) so the spell can be relied upon by the root as an authorized caller.
Public entry point cast() which requires the spell not to be already cast, marks done and calls execute().
Internal execute() that relies the spell on the NAV feed via root and files the new risk groups 6-10 on the NAV feed.
External privileged call root.relyContract(NAV_FEED, self) granting the spell contract authority over the NAV feed (in-place privilege escalation).
External configuration call navFeed.file('riskGroup', ...) repeated for risk groups 6,7,8,9,10 with rate and recovery rate parameters.
Local variable root typed TinlakeRootLike(address(ROOT)) used to make the relyContract call.
Local variable navFeed typed NAVFeedLike(address(NAV_FEED)) used to file risk group parameters.

edges.reason: cast() reads the done state variable in require(!done, 'spell-already-cast') to gate execution.
cast() writes done = true before calling execute(), mutating the guard state variable.
cast() invokes the internal execute() function after setting the done flag.
execute() performs the privileged external call root.relyContract(NAV_FEED, self) that grants the spell authority over the NAV feed.
execute() invokes navFeed.file(...) five times to configure the new risk groups on the NAV feed.
local root is the receiver of the relyContract call and therefore the handle carrying the privilege-granting operation.
local navFeed is the receiver used for all the file() calls that write the risk group parameters.
ROOT constant is cast into the local variable root used for the privileged external call.
NAV_FEED constant is passed as the target address of the relyContract privileged call.
NAV_FEED constant is cast into the local variable navFeed used for the configuration calls.
state variable self (= address(this)) is passed to relyContract as the authorized address, tying the spell's own identity to the privilege grant.
constant ONE and the ray-scaled rate/recovery values (e.g. 99.5*10**25) flow as ratio arguments into the risk group filing calls.

normalization_plan.reason: The local variable root only exists to perform the privileged external relyContract call, so it can be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
The local variable navFeed only exists to perform the external file() configuration calls, so it can be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
